rules.statement: A servitude is one and indivisible, meaning it must be shown legally to exist at each and every point on the strip of land over which it is claimed. If the claimant fails to prove its existence at any one of such points, the servitude disappears not at that point only but at every other point.
rules.supporting_quote: "Servitude is one and indivisible, in the sense that it must be shown legally to exist at each and every point on the strip of land over which it is claimed and if the claimant fail to prove its existence at any one of such points, the servitude disappears not at that point only but at every other point."
